$doc.what: Every file in this folder, in LOAD ORDER. tools/build.mjs injects them in this order (not alphabetical), tools/assemble-bank.mjs evaluates the headless ones in this order, and tools/test-module-contract.mjs holds every claim below against the running app. A *.js file that is not listed here fails the build. Read through tools/module-manifest.mjs, never directly.
$doc.id: Stable name other entries refer to. Renaming a file does not change it.
$doc.kind: content-pack (adds cards, doctrine, scenarios or terms to the bank as it loads) | feature (a screen or a service) | finalize (the one pass that tags and fingerprints the finished bank; every content-pack must load before it) | release-note (a What's New entry).
$doc.headless: true = tools/assemble-bank.mjs also evaluates this file with no page, so it must load cleanly with no DOM. Every content-pack and the finalize pass must be headless, or the content lints and the handheld card exporter never see what they add.
$doc.emit: build (this file calls G.contentPack.define(id, builder) - tools/content-pack-engine.mjs runs it once, at build time, merging its result into the shipped seed; tools/build.mjs never splices it in as a <script>, so it never runs a second time in a real page) | runtime (an ordinary <script>, spliced into the page as always). Every content-pack and finalize entry MUST be "build". Every other kind defaults to "runtime" when omitted; writing "runtime" explicitly is also allowed.
$doc.requires: ids of modules whose API this one calls. The build guarantees each of them loads EARLIER.
$doc.uses: ids of modules this one calls that load LATER. Only safe because those calls happen at run time, after every module has loaded - declared here so the exception is visible instead of implicit.
$doc.provides: Public API names other code may call (core, other modules, the shell scripts in src/, tools). Each must exist in the running app. A guarded call such as typeof G.x.y === "function" that points into a module must name something that module lists here.
$doc.routes: Routes whose screen this module draws. Each must be registered, and its render must call into this module.
$doc.storageKeys: Keys this module owns and writes in the app's on-device store (kv rows or localStorage). A trailing * is a prefix. Found by a static scan of the module's own write calls - it cannot see a write made on the module's behalf by a core API such as G.reminders.add or G.store.recordAttempt; those rows belong to core.
$doc.clearsKeys: Keys owned elsewhere that this module only deletes.
$doc.optionalApis: { name, why }: a guarded API that may legitimately be missing, with the written reason. A guarded name that is missing and NOT listed (here or under core) fails the contract test; a listed name that exists in every build must be removed from the list.
$doc.patches: { name, when, why }: a function owned by core or another module that this module REPLACES. when=load: swapped while the file loads (the contract test sees it happen and fails on an undeclared one). when=call: swapped for the length of one of the module's own calls and put back.
$doc.hooks: Named extension points (G.ext.on) this module subscribes to. The supported way to add to a core screen - no wrapping.
$doc.core: core.extensionPoints: the points src/index.html runs (G.ext.run). core.optionalApis: guarded APIs that live outside src/app-modules and may be missing.

modules.note: Runs at build time (tools/content-pack-engine.mjs) via G.contentPack.define(); mergeDeck and the shared boardSupplement audit object are exposed to modules that declare this id under "requires", through ctx.pack("board-supplement-core") - not on window.G, which this file never touches at runtime any more.

ROADMAP 3g item G. The catalog + opt-in API every MOS content pack (92A today) registers into and every runtime consumer (store.boardQuestions()/scenarios(), the Readiness tab, Settings) reads, so 'which MOS decks exist' and 'is this one active for this Soldier' each have exactly one definition. storageKeys lists "mosOptIn" because tools/module-contract.mjs's storage scan matches ANY `.setSetting(` call by name, not just db's own - setOptedIn() calls G.store.setSetting("mosOptIn", ...), which edits one field of the single "settings" kv row (DEFAULT_SETTINGS.mosOptIn in src/index.html), not a standalone kv key; lint-storage-contract.mjs's own setSetting scan already excludes store.setSetting for exactly this reason (see its comment), so no new KV_VALIDATORS entry is needed.

Registers the #/board-sim, #/team and #/pt-plan routes on behalf of the three modules under "uses" (each of those lists its own route), adds the PT reminder kind, and carries the collective scenario runner. It also owns G.roomHandoffAdapters, the empty kind -> adapter map PT Planner and Team Training fill in as they load and Study Rooms reads when a room offer arrives, so none of those three depends on the others' load order.
